stories.title: A new base for exploring Hokkaido
stories.summary: Hyatt Centric Sapporo opened on October 3, becoming the brand's first hotel in Hokkaido. Its 216 rooms and suites sit near Odori Park and the former Hokkaido Government Office Building; JR Sapporo Station is about a ten-minute walk away. For travelers planning time in northern Japan, the opening adds a centrally located Hyatt option. Award pricing and availability still need checking for your dates.

image.alt: Odori Park seen from Sapporo TV Tower in July 2023
image.caption: Odori Park, Sapporo, photographed July 9, 2023. Destination image, not the new hotel. Displayed without edits.

paragraphs: Hyatt Centric Sapporo opened on October 3, giving travelers another Hyatt option in northern Japan. It is the brand’s first hotel in Hokkaido, adding a central city base for visitors heading to the island’s mountains, hot springs and seasonal attractions.

The hotel occupies upper floors of a mixed-use tower near the historic Red Brick Building and Odori Park. Hyatt describes it as a base for discovering Sapporo and the wider island, including Hokkaido’s ski resorts, hot springs and national parks.
keyPoints: 216 guestrooms and suites, starting at 36 square meters.
About a ten-minute walk from JR Sapporo Station, with an underground walkway connection toward Odori subway station.
On-site dining includes Matsu Grill & Bar and Mr. Fish.
stories.takeaway: Use Sapporo as the city stop in a wider Hokkaido itinerary. This location puts Odori Park within reach and JR Sapporo Station about ten minutes away on foot—handy for combining city sightseeing with onward rail travel.

stories.title: Alaska and Hawaiian outline their next premium cabins
stories.summary:
Alaska's Aurora and Hawaiian's Leihōkū plans include upgraded lie-flat suites, while Premium Reserve introduces another premium-economy option on specified aircraft beginning in 2028. The announcement describes future changes, rather than a cabin available across today's flights. Aircraft and rollout timing will matter when comparing tickets. .
.
paragraphs: Alaska and Hawaiian announced their next premium-cabin plans on September 29. Aurora for Alaska and Leihōkū for Hawaiian cover upgraded lie-flat suite experiences; Premium Reserve adds another premium-economy option on specified aircraft beginning in 2028.

The changes extend beyond seats to the airport experience. Alaska’s Seattle lounge expansion is planned for late 2027, while Hawaiian’s new Honolulu lounge is planned for early 2028. These announcements describe future products rather than a fleet-wide change travelers can book today.
keyPoints: Aurora plans include Alaska’s 787 aircraft and select transcontinental 737-10 MAX flights.
Leihōkū enhancements include redesigned suites on Hawaiian’s A330 fleet.
Premium Reserve is planned for specified Alaska 787 and 737-10 MAX aircraft and Hawaiian A330s.
stories.takeaway: When comparing a future premium flight, look at the aircraft as well as the airline. Match the cabin you want to the aircraft named in these plans, then check the seat layout for the departure you are considering.

stories.title: Chase launches IHG Premier Select with a 200,000-point welcome offer
stories.summary: The IHG One Rewards Premier Select card has a $350 annual fee. Its launch offer awards 200,000 points after $5,000 in purchases within the first three months of account opening; Chase says the launch offers run through November 18. Benefits include an anniversary free night capped at 60,000 points, with the option to add your own points, and 20 annual elite-night credits. Existing IHG cardholders should read their individual notices: benefit effective dates vary, and annual-fee adjustments are scheduled for 2027. Check the issuer's eligibility and offer terms before applying.

terms.eligibilityNote: New cardmember eligibility and issuer terms apply.

paragraphs: Chase and IHG introduced Premier Select on October 1 as a higher-fee option for IHG travelers. Its benefits combine an anniversary hotel night, elite-night credits and loyalty status with a limited-time welcome offer.

The announcement also changes the existing IHG card portfolio. Current cardholders should follow their individual notices: benefit effective dates vary, and annual-fee adjustments are scheduled for 2027.
keyPoints: Premier Select costs $350 annually; the launch bonus requires $5,000 in purchases within the first three months.
The anniversary free night is capped at 60,000 points, with the option to add your own IHG points.
20 annual elite-night credits and automatic Platinum Elite status are included.
stories.takeaway: Start with a hotel where you would use the anniversary free night. Look up its points price, see how the 60,000-point certificate would fit, and compare that stay’s cash price with the $350 annual fee. That gives you a concrete starting point for judging the card’s ongoing value.

stories.title: Hyatt’s luxury expansion puts Mexico in focus
stories.summary: Hyatt expects Park Hyatt Riviera Maya to open by the end of 2026 as its first all-inclusive Park Hyatt. Park Hyatt Mexico City Polanco is expected in spring 2027. Separately, Impression Isla Mujeres is scheduled to join The Unbound Collection by Hyatt on November 2. These are upcoming openings and a collection transition; they do not establish award availability or new booking discounts.
paragraphs: Hyatt’s September 29 update puts several upcoming Mexican properties on the radar for luxury travel. The most distinctive addition is Park Hyatt Riviera Maya, expected by the end of 2026 as the first all-inclusive Park Hyatt.

The expansion reaches beyond beachfront resorts. Park Hyatt Mexico City Polanco is planned for the capital, while the existing adults-only, all-inclusive Impression Isla Mujeres is set to join The Unbound Collection by Hyatt. The update gives travelers several distinct properties to watch as they plan future stays.
keyPoints: Park Hyatt Riviera Maya: expected to open by the end of 2026.
Park Hyatt Mexico City Polanco: expected in spring 2027, with 155 rooms and suites overlooking Chapultepec Park.
Impression Isla Mujeres: scheduled to join The Unbound Collection by Hyatt on November 2.
stories.takeaway: Build your Mexico shortlist around the kind of trip you want: Riviera Maya for a beach resort stay, Polanco for exploring Mexico City, or Impression Isla Mujeres for an adults-only island escape.
